synthesis.decision: Gearbox v1 verified baseline is immutable under v2/v2.1 candidate FAIL/DEFER. Candidate defects only block candidate adoption.

Current v2.1 caller booleans secretary_signal_fresh/authority_conflict are insufficient. Secretary influence is forbidden for formal/adoptable mode until freshness and authority conflict are derived from a replay-resistant envelope bound to signal hash, source, issued/observed time, TTL policy and exact fresh authority snapshot. W07 receipt is stale relative to W07 latest and therefore cannot be treated as fresh GREEN.

Anti-thrash may suppress only nonessential upshift. Risk/recovery downshift remains immediate and lower guard engages first; current code structurally applies anti-thrash only when selected gear is above current gear.

recent_shift_rate_ratio threshold 0.50 is heuristic and lacks denominator/window/minimum support/cooldown. Require clean baseline plus incident replay, false-positive/missed-warning counts, bounded recovery/upshift latency and throughput non-regression.

event_id-only dedupe is not sufficient. Same evidence replayed with new event IDs can inflate verified Experience. Require canonical evidence/event lineage key including evidence_hash, provenance/source lineage and trusted verification receipt identity; event_id may be index only.

bool(independently_verified) is unsafe because non-empty strings such as 'false' become true. Verified Experience requires strict typed trusted receipt bound to exact payload/evidence hash, verifier identity/policy, mission/step and acceptance/revocation state.

No speedup is established. Only paired matched-workload metrics may support a claim: durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with verification/risk non-regression. Window age, commit count and task last_run are forbidden speed evidence.

Pressure score and gear thresholds remain engineering heuristics, not probabilities. Require clean baseline + incident replay + TP/FP/TN/FN or false-positive/missed-warning statistics before threshold adoption.

Heartbeat/window age/poll/retry/reconnect/scheduler wake are zero Experience. DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only. P_base, Identity, Personality and Governance remain unchanged.

Formal-candidate readiness requires one exact-current runner executing v1 tests + v2 tests + v2.1 tests together. Existing v2 16/16 selftest is draft-equivalent and explicitly not exact-current/C verified; current v2.1 tests do not cover the active veto cases.

required_adversarial_tests: stale/forged secretary freshness and newer-authority conflict must fail closed
timestamp rollback/forward jump and replayed secretary envelope cannot regain freshness
same canonical evidence replayed under many event_ids credits exactly once
non-bool verification values including 'false' fail closed
same event_id with different evidence is identity conflict
anti-thrash small-n inputs cannot trigger production behavior absent minimum-support policy
transient thrash burst cannot indefinitely suppress required safe upshift; safety/recovery downshift remains immediate
paired matched baseline/candidate speed benchmark excludes window age, commits and task last_run
clean baseline + incident replay records false positives and missed warnings for pressure/gear thresholds
